verdict.rationale: CDP provides extensive first-party documentation (515 pages via llms.txt) covering REST-style API endpoints, client SDKs (cdp-sdk on GitHub), a CLI, webhooks, and a sandbox environment, all clearly documented as a programmatic interface for driving payments/wallet features. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (all candidate paths 404) and independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
